main_body: A three-tier votive candle rack: three thin grey shelf bars (rows ~14-15, 19-20, 24-25), each carrying a row of small candles, above a dark open frame with a base bar at rows 29-30
top_band: Light grey band at rows 14-15 (about 1-2 rows), repeated at rows 19-20 and 24-25; no real horizontal surface is visible
evidence: Each shelf is a 1-2 row grey strip, too thin to read as a surface seen from above, so it works as a rim line. The candles and the frame are drawn straight from the front, like an elevation. There is no front-edge highlight or eave shadow. The lower frame is a dark flat silhouette with no readable top surface. The tiers do not match the guide's 3/4 seat or table (top 5 rows plus legs).

style.evidence: The shelves have only about 2-3 grey tones, and the candles are tiny 2-3 colour dots. The dark lower frame is a large, nearly flat fill. There is no grain, wear or per-material ramp, and most tiles carry only 2-4 colours. Next to the richly textured stall and well references it looks thin and flat.
